description: SEO fixes from Week 2 report: Add internal links to blog posts from homepage, service pages, and guide pages to accelerate blog indexing. Fix keyword cannibalization between /directory and /best/* pages. Blog posts are currently 'unknown to Google' because they have near-zero internal links pointing to them.

userStories.title: Add blog linking utility functions to lib/links.ts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need functions to find blog posts related to a given service or guide topic, so that service and guide pages can link to relevant blog content. Add two new functions to lib/links.ts: (1) getRelatedPostsForService(serviceSlug: string): LinkItem[] — calls getAllPosts() from lib/data, filters to posts whose relatedServices array includes the serviceSlug, sorts by publishedAt descending, slices to 3, maps to { title: post.title, href: `/blog/${post.slug}`, description: post.description }. (2) getRelatedPostsForTopic(topicSlug: string): LinkItem[] — same logic but filters on relatedTopics array instead. Both functions should return LinkItem[] (the existing interface in lib/links.ts). Import getAllPosts from ./data (already imported in the file).
acceptanceCriteria: getRelatedPostsForService is exported from lib/links.ts
getRelatedPostsForTopic is exported from lib/links.ts
Both return LinkItem[] matching the existing interface { title, href, description }
getRelatedPostsForService filters posts by relatedServices array containing the slug
getRelatedPostsForTopic filters posts by relatedTopics array containing the slug
Both sort by publishedAt descending and limit to 3 results
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: getAllPosts is already imported in lib/links.ts on line 8. The LinkItem interface is defined on line 12-16.

userStories.title: Add 'Latest from the Blog' section to homepage
userStories.description: As a visitor, I want to see recent blog posts on the homepage so I can discover blog content. Add a new section to app/page.tsx between the 'Neighborhood Guides' section (ends around line 132) and 'Where to Stay' section (starts around line 134). Import getRecentPosts from @/lib/data. Call getRecentPosts(3) to get the 3 most recent posts. Render a section with heading 'Latest from the Blog', a 3-column responsive grid (1 col mobile, 2 tablet, 3 desktop) of blog post cards. Each card should have: the post image (aspect-video, with hover zoom), a category badge (uppercase, small text), the post title as a Link to /blog/{slug}, and the description truncated to 2 lines. Add a 'Read more on the blog →' link to /blog below the grid. Style should match existing homepage sections (same heading size, spacing, card borders). Wrap in a try/catch like the topics section in case posts.json doesn't exist during build.
acceptanceCriteria: Homepage has a 'Latest from the Blog' section between Neighborhood Guides and Where to Stay
Section displays 3 most recent blog posts in a responsive grid
Each card shows image, category badge, linked title, and description
Each card links to /blog/{slug}
'Read more on the blog →' link points to /blog
Section is wrapped in try/catch for build safety
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use getRecentPosts(3) from @/lib/data. Follow the same card pattern used in app/blog/page.tsx for consistency. The homepage already imports Image and Link from next.

userStories.title: Fix keyword cannibalization on /directory page
userStories.description: As an SEO practitioner, I need the /directory page to not compete with /best/* pages for category-specific queries like 'best restaurants liberty village'. In app/directory/page.tsx, update the static metadata object: (1) Change title to 'Liberty Village Business Directory — Browse All Local Businesses | libertyvillage.co'. (2) Change description to 'Browse and search the complete Liberty Village business directory. Find local shops, services, and businesses in your neighborhood.' (remove specific category mentions like 'restaurants'). (3) Change openGraph title to 'Liberty Village Business Directory — Browse All'. (4) Change openGraph description to 'Browse and search the complete Liberty Village business directory.' These changes differentiate /directory (browse/search all) from /best/* (curated category guides) to reduce keyword overlap.
acceptanceCriteria: Directory page title no longer contains category-specific words like 'restaurants' or 'services'
Directory page title includes 'Browse All Local Businesses'
Directory page description focuses on 'browse and search' rather than listing specific categories
OpenGraph title and description are updated to match
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The metadata object is at lines 7-23 of app/directory/page.tsx. Only change the text strings, not the structure.
